- Scope: this stan"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"dalone Stent extension workspace
- Upstream anchors: deepseek-harness snapshots `7b9644f2` (0812) / "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"`9f9e2782a4` (0813),
fork tip `65bcaf9902` (`feat-stent`)"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This document explains *why* this repository is shaped the way it is. Every
non-obvious arrangement "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"below was reached through a concrete failure recorded
in the commit history; the sections follow the"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" repository's evolution rather
than its file layout."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 1. Purpose: an external Stent extension, not a fork"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"deepseek-harness is a private monorepo. The Stent/Mixin extension layer lives
there as three impleme"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ntation packages, but a consumer cannot install them from
the registry. This repository externalizes"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" those three packages and publishes
the `@oh-my-dsh/stent-pack` carrier so consumers can install the"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" complete bundle
through the official plugin channel:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**Boundary (hard rule):** the workspace contains exactly three complete
implementation packages — `s"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"tent` (pure transformation service),
`stent-api` (pure compat facade), and `stent-dsh` (DSH-facing
f"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"acades, invariant, profile bootstrap). The root `@oh-my-dsh/stent-pack` is a
separately publishable "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"carrier, not a fourth implementation package. Anything
else — including the official `@deepseek-ai/d"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"sh-tool-cordis` toolset — remains
an upstream dependency and is not republished here."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## 2. Host integration: import-owned activation"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The three packages install hooks and mount facades through the compiled loader.
`src/stent-dsh.ts` c"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ompiles to `lib/stent-dsh.js`, while
`src/stent-loader.ts` compiles to `lib/stent-loader.js`. The bi"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"n is a thin
command wrapper: it selects the command, injects the compiled loader through
`NODE_OPTIO"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"NS=--import ...`, and forwards execution. Importing the loader is the
activation boundary. The loade"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"r installs hooks for the importing process and
performs profile composition, dependency healing, arg"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"v normalization, and
environment setup only when the current entry is the official DSH CLI. It stati"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"cally imports the official profile
composition and healing APIs from the DSH-provided `@deepseek-ai/"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"dsh-app-boot` peer;
the carrier does not bundle a second app-boot copy. No host patch checkout is re"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"quired.
The loader also records process-local Stent activation, so Stent-dependent
plugins stay unav"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"ailable under `dsh` without the loader import, even if
low-level hooks were installed by another pat"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"h. The same
capability gate is enforced by `getStent(ctx)`: a plugin that omitted
`inject: ['stent']"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"` cannot mount the registry through the accessor under plain
`dsh` and fails loudly instead."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Everything the official channels already cover is deliberately excluded:
installing the trio (`dsh p"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"lugin add`), bundle roster rows and dependencies,
catalog generation, invariant/gate exemptions for "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"trio-in-workspace, and all
documentation (`README*`, `docs/`, `.agents/`). What remains is what no
c"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"hannel can provide: the import-owned loader/bootstrap and its tests, the
`clientBundle` source-trans"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"form build seam, catalog entries compiled into the
official `tool-cordis` package, and the pnpm-poli"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"d seam, catalog entries compiled into the
official `tool-cordis` package, and the pnpm-policy seams."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### 2.1 The disabled opt-in rows"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The web-app bundle layer inserts the `stent` / `stent-dsh` rows as
**disabled opt-ins**. A dynamic p"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"atch plugin marks its row with a Stent
configuration marker (for example `config: { stent: true }`);"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" the launcher
only uses that marker to enable the row through a generated overlay. It never
extracts"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" patch metadata from YAML. Plugin code registers the target metadata
and executable handler through "},{"id":"p14s5","text":"`ctx.stent.register()` after `installStentHooks()` has
been installed. Plain `dsh` leaves these rows"},{"id":"p14s6","text":".register()` after `installStentHooks()` has
been installed. Plain `dsh` leaves these rows disabled."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### 2.2 Dynamic patch registration"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The Node launcher installs `installStentHooks()` before the
official CLI imports target plugins. A p"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"lugin's `ctx.stent.register({ id,
target, operation, priority, required, handler })` call is the sin"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"gle source of
truth for a patch: runtime metadata updates the loader matcher, while the
handler rema"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"ins in process memory and is never serialized. New imports use the
new matcher immediately. If a tar"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"get was already loaded, the loader schedules
CJS/ESM cache re-transformation under the new matcher w"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"hen the synchronous Node
hooks are available; an async loader-thread fallback applies the update to
"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"us Node
hooks are available; an async loader-thread fallback applies the update to
future ESM loads."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Removing a patch refreshes the matcher and re-transforms loaded targets when
possible. Enabling or d"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"isabling a handler does not need a code transform,
because transformed bridge calls dispatch against"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" the live runtime registry.
`required: true` is checked from the runtime registry after boot, not fr"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"om a
YAML descriptor list. Profile YAML may mark a row as Stent-dependent for
activation, but it mus"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"t not contain `config.stent.patches` descriptors."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### 2.3 Public API boundaries"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The `@oh-my-dsh/stent` package is intentionally split by platform:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- `@oh-my-dsh/stent` — platform-free runtime, bridge, service, and patch types;
- `@oh-my-dsh/stent/"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"loader` — Node hook installation, binding flush, and cache re-transformation;
- `@oh-my-dsh/stent/br"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"owser` — build transforms, package identity resolvers, and runtime bundle serving;
- `@oh-my-dsh/ste"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"nt/client` — browser Cordis client artifact;
- `@oh-my-dsh/stent/testing` — isolated child-process f"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"t` — browser Cordis client artifact;
- `@oh-my-dsh/stent/testing` — isolated child-process fixtures."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Orchestrion configuration, wire serialization, module identity internals, and
loader-thread implemen"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"tation remain private under `packages/stent/src/transform`
and `packages/stent/src/loader`. Browser "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"transforms accept public `StentPatchStub`
arrays and convert them internally; Node hooks read only t"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"he live runtime
registry. The package no longer exports platform implementation files as
compatibili"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ime
